viewing_check: Check the split near the lock (length, through the panel?), whether the birdseye panels are solid Huon pine or veneer, the illegible stencil/label on the right door, original hooks and shelf, stain on frame (removable?), and any maker label or number inside. Also measure the width against the 121cm listed and check for borer.
